data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: code-reviewer-deep-correctness.md and code-reviewer-standard.md have a generic 'aliased import resolution' rule (line 95 of each) that says 'use Grep to search' but does NOT mandate verification BEFORE emitting a critical/important finding. Result: false-positive NameError reports for symbols whose defining import lives outside the diff hunk. Proposed fix: strengthen rule 4 in both agents — 'If the symbol is used in the diff but no defining import appears in the diff hunk, you MUST Grep the file for import.*<symbol> and as <symbol> before setting severity critical or important. Finding blocked until the Grep result is known.' Add two PR examples as in-agent reminders. Classification: MODERATE — two agent prompt files + benefits from a fixture-based regression test. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
